applied_lessons: Lead with the hospital outcome and the buyer’s work
Give clinical, operations, finance and IT stakeholders a reason to care
Begin with one concrete process and include training
Use the buyer’s own numbers instead of invented ROI
Keep development scope and future AI services clear
Use specific, verified proof and offer a reference conversation

founder_feedback_incorporated: Next five hospital partners, with allocated implementation capacity
Free implementation and tailored base-system development
Free parallel evaluation while the existing system continues
Match current software budget for the agreed base scope
Hospital ownership of the first delivered base-system source code, defined in the agreement
Natural Georgian instead of literal translated slogans
Larger text, fewer words, stronger visual hierarchy and brand consistency
